# Draft:GP Staking

General Partner Staking (GP Staking) is an alternative investment strategy in which an investor or fund invests in an alternative asset manager's management company. This differs to a traditional investment where the capital is committed to a fund or an asset managed by the GP.
This strategy is deemed to be defensive relative to other alternative strategies as GP staking investors seek returns from :
1) their pro-rata share of the management and performance fees collected by the GP
2) their pro-rata share of the GP's commitment in the underlying portfolio funds
3) the capital appreciation of their equity stake in the GP as their business grows.
